# BA2 test fixtures

These fixtures are tracked so the test suite is reproducible in a clean checkout
and in CI. They were copied from the `bsa-rs`/`ba2` fixture corpus and renamed at
the directory level to describe the BA2 behavior being tested rather than the
crate or game-specific source tree they came from.

The upstream fixture corpus is licensed under the BSD Zero Clause License
(`0BSD`), which permits reuse, modification, and redistribution. This repository
is licensed as `GPL-3.0-only`.
